# The Spanish Experiment

> > Free Spanish lessons with audio and bilingual children's stories for language learners of all levels

The Spanish Experiment offers beginner-friendly Spanish grammar lessons with native audio, bilingual fairy tales and children's stories, and reviews of popular Spanish learning courses like Rocket Spanish and Ouino Spanish.

## Key Topics

- Spanish grammar fundamentals
- Beginner Spanish lessons
- Bilingual children's stories
- Free audio lessons
- Spanish vocabulary building
- Conversational Spanish
- Spanish-English bilingual content
- False cognates and common mistakes
- Spanish learning course reviews
- Native Spanish audio narration
- Fairy tales in Spanish
- Question words and interrogatives
- Time expressions in Spanish
- Greetings and basic phrases

## Getting Started

- [Spanish Children's Stories & Free Spanish Lessons: The Spanish Experiment](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com): Homepage: Spanish stories, free lessons, and course reviews for learners
- [Free Online Spanish Lessons with Audio - The Spanish Experiment](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish): Main Spanish lessons hub with audio grammar lessons for beginners
- [Spanish Children's Stories - The Spanish Experiment](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/stories): Collection of bilingual children's stories with native Spanish audio
- [About us](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/about): About The Spanish Experiment and founder Aletta's story

## Beginner Spanish Lessons

- [How to say "hello" and "goodbye" in Spanish](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/greetings): Basic Spanish greetings and farewell phrases for beginners
- [Question Words in Spanish - Free Online Spanish Lessons](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/question-words): Beginner lesson on Spanish interrogatives and question words
- [How to tell the time in Spanish (lesson + audio)](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/telling-time): Time expressions and telling time in Spanish with audio examples
- [Getting directions in Spanish (Free lesson + audio)](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/directions): Directions and location vocabulary lesson with audio examples
- [Feelings and moods in Spanish: Vocabulary and phrases](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/feelings): Emotions and mood vocabulary with Spanish phrases and expressions

## Spanish Grammar

- ["Está" vs "Hay": Which should you use?](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/esta-or-hay): Grammar lesson explaining difference between está and hay usage
- [How to make comparisons in Spanish (Free lesson + audio)](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/comparisons): Spanish comparisons grammar lesson with audio examples
- [Spanish Plurals - Free Online Spanish Lessons](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/plurals): Spanish plurals grammar rules and formation lesson
- [Negation in Spanish - Free Online Spanish Lessons](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/negation): How to form negative statements and use 'no' in Spanish
- [Spanish False Cognates: 9 words that will trip you up](https://www.thespanishexperiment.com/learn-spanish/false-friends): False cognates lesson covering 9 common Spanish vocabulary mistakes
